title: Agent Physics Demo Scene v1 (v1.0.0 routes)

validation.description: visual: prioritize video delivery, keep precision warnings; strict: require all numerical checks. Raw API default strict.

particle_gravity_density.description: Shared reference particle density for self-gravity; particle mass = density * effective_spacing^3.

gravity_theta.description: Barnes-Hut opening angle; 0 evaluates exact pairs. Default 0.5 for visual, 0 for strict.

connection.description: Massless links between distinct existing point masses. Connection IDs must be unique; endpoint references and numerical feasibility are checked at runtime. Spring stiffness is N/m and damping N*s/m. Rod length is fixed; rope is tension-only.

mesh_asset.description: One connected, consistently wound triangle surface. Runtime checks indices, degeneracy, manifold edges/vertices, self-intersection and outward closed winding; saved audit fields are recomputed.

collision_radius.description: Coupled route only. Zero disables contact; values in [0.0001,10] m provide a collision sphere around the point.

preset.description: Canonical liquid behavior and appearance preset. Explicit properties override its model coefficients.

slider.description: Common X-rail model only; all slider centre Y/Z and size Y/Z must agree and initial X extents must not overlap. Runtime validates cross-entity constraints.

query_metric.description: Connection metrics target an existing connection; spring_force/spring_energy require a spring. Entity targets must name existing entities. spread_radius requires particles or mesh vertices; volume_ratio requires a closed mesh, max_displacement/max_edge_strain require a mesh. surface_gap requires two rigid spheres, two static boxes, or two sliders and excludes arbitrary meshes. Runtime validates those semantic restrictions. Angular metrics require rigid_body: world angular speed (rad/s), world angular-momentum axis component (kg*m^2/s), rotational kinetic energy (J), and angle between body +Y and world +Y (rad). Pivot momentum/energy are about the fixed anchor.

query.description: Query IDs must be unique; hold_for cannot exceed world.duration. N-body stability requires at least two nonfixed, mutually gravitating point masses, positive G and no targeted external fields. Runtime validates these cross-field constraints.

quaternion.description: Unit quaternion [w,x,y,z] mapping body coordinates to world coordinates. Runtime checks norm within 1e-6 and normalizes it.

rotating_shape.description: Uniform solid geometry centered at the COM. Cylinder axis is local Y; principal inertia is derived from shape and mass.

rigid_body.description: World COM position, world linear/angular velocity, and body-to-world attitude. A fixed pivot uses COM-relative local_point on one principal axis. Runtime checks pivot consistency, COM velocity omega x (COM-pivot), positive inertia and initial geometry.

coupled_attachment.description: point_mass: entity only; mesh: entity plus local vertex index; rigid_body: entity and optional COM-relative local_point. Runtime checks endpoint type and local distance <=100 m.

coupled_connection.description: Mixed-route spring/rod/rope attachment. Optional solid is a straight collision capsule; it is not resolved helical wire. Positive mass is allowed only between point masses and is split half to each endpoint. Runtime checks geometry, attachment types and stiffness planning.
